Task: `pathfind.rs` is the void_engine grid A* module. It is 4-connected: units move orthogonally only, so a diagonal run costs two steps per cell.

Add a new public function `astar_bool_grid_8` that does the same job but 8-connected — the four orthogonal steps plus the four diagonals — with the same signature and the same conventions as `astar_bool_grid` (path excludes the start, includes the goal, empty Vec when start == goal, None when unreachable). Every step costs the same, whether orthogonal or diagonal.

Leave the existing functions working exactly as they are. The tests in test.rs specify the behaviour; make them pass.

The change is verified by running: rustc --test --edition 2021 -o t_engine.exe test.rs && ./t_engine.exe
Make that command exit 0. Do not edit any test files.
